forms.label: Fresh
forms.sourceNote: Raspberries, raw. Public domain. No density: the fruit is macerated and strained out, and the record's own figure is a cup of whole berries.

forms.label: Purée, seedless
forms.sourceNote: Raspberries, puree, seedless. Public domain. What remains after whole raspberries are cooked briefly and pressed through a fine sieve to remove the seeds, which is the form this record's own syrup preparations use. No measured liquid density is published; the purée is genuinely poured, so the density-classes.json 'juice-sweet' class is adopted and marked estimated.
